speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal X-ray rules out a fracture or major structural damage. Given the localized medial tibial pain, recent increase in volleyball activity, and negative exam for swelling or instability, this is consistent with medial tibial stress syndrome (shin splints).

DIAGNOSIS READY: Medial Tibial Stress Syndrome
